result.summary: The page is largely intact; excluded edge-clipped carousel items and bottom-cutoff cards are treated as features. Found 2 minor issues: an implausible '-100%' discount label and low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' discount badge, which is ambiguous/implausible as a discount value (it implies a free item) and may be a data or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Verify the intended promotion value and display it clearly, e.g. '-10%' or '100% off', so users are not misled.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as delivery fees and '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' uses light gray on white/dark imagery and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of secondary text to meet WCAG AA (at least 4.5:1) by darkening the gray or adding a scrim behind text on images.
